stories.title: Sportiqe's Utah roots run deep. Now it's teaming up with the Utah Utes
stories.summary: After years of working with Utah sports and ski resorts, Sportiqe is bringing its local connections to the University of Utah.

stories.title: John Curtis raises concern over Trump's new pick for watchdog agency
stories.summary: Sen. John Curtis is raising concerns about President Donald Trump's new pick to lead the Government Accountability Office.

stories.title: FBI investigation in Pittsburgh and West Virginia leads to arrest of Utah man
stories.summary: A child sex abuse material investigation conducted by FBI agents in Pittsburgh has resulted in the arrested of a Pleasant Grove man.

stories.title: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries is nominated to become House speaker, a historic first
stories.summary: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be speaker of the House, brushing past skeptics and putting him on track to make history as the first Black American with the speaker's gavel.

stories.title: The risk of CO poisoning rises as the temperatures drop, Utah agencies remind
stories.summary: Utah agencies want to get ahead of potential carbon monoxide problems this winter with a reminder about the the dangers of carbon monoxide, and how to avoid them.

stories.title: Dropping truths: Utah receivers looking for improvement after drops start to stack
stories.summary: Contested catches have been a sore point the last couple weeks for Utah wide receivers, who have had an uncharacteristic amount of dropped passes.

stories.title: Intermountain Health celebrates new LDS Hospital downtown, but when will construction begin?
stories.summary: Intermountain Health celebrated the beginning of construction of a brand new LDS Hospital, but the state's largest healthcare provider is still awaiting formal approval.

stories.title: Utah organizing committee begins process of choosing official 2034 Olympic emblems
stories.summary: The 2034 Olympic organizing committee has issued a request for proposals, the first step toward revealing the official emblems for the 2034 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games.

stories.title: Trump seeks to show strength in China, but series of tech snafus raises concerns at home
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has landed in China, where he is seeking to reinforce the U.S. as a leading tech power even as digital service outages at home are causing concerns.

stories.title: Draper man federally indicted for selling drugs that led to Utahn's death
stories.summary: A Draper man is facing federal charges after an alleged drug client of his overdosed and died in a convenience store restroom.

stories.title: Teen organ donor to be honored on 2027 Rose Parade float
stories.summary: Morgan White, whose organ donation saved four lives after a rare genetic heart condition claimed her life, will be honored on the OneLegacy Donate Life float at the 2027 Rose Parade.

stories.title: Parker Kingston's lawyers seek to disqualify prosecutor from rape case
stories.summary: Shortly after the Washington County attorney refiled a rape charge against Parker Kingston, his lawyers asked a judge to remove the prosecutor and his office from the case.
